meta.description: Mapping from ISO 18245 MCC codes to SKR03/SKR04 accounts for German business accounting

confidence_levels.high: MCC determines account in >90% of cases for typical SME
confidence_levels.medium: MCC suggests most likely account but alternatives are common (30-50%)
confidence_levels.low: MCC is ambiguous — multiple equally valid accounts possible

meta.notes: This mapping assumes a typical German SME (Einzelunternehmen, GmbH, UG). Industry-specific mappings may differ. Always confirm with Steuerberater for edge cases.
